reason: Melting some ice is the necessary first step toward filtering out its grit, and this is the only offered action.
expectation: I expect the sealed melter to produce meltwater containing the trapped material; I am unsure how the banded record will be preserved.

effect: The melter used an ordinary chip, leaving the banded record frozen. The cloudy meltwater is ready to filter.
reaction: That resolves my uncertainty about preserving the ice record.
reason: Filtering the meltwater is the only offered combination and should remove the visible grit.
expectation: I expect the cloth to catch suspended particles, though dissolved material may remain in the water.

effect: The cloth removed the grit, and the new goal is to examine what remains after the clear water dries.
reaction: I’m curious whether the water will leave a visible residue.
reason: The evaporation dish is the only offered combination and directly serves the new goal.
expectation: I expect the water to evaporate and leave any dissolved material behind, though there may be little visible residue.

effect: Evaporation revealed salt crystals in the filtered water, showing why the processor must remove dissolved contaminants as well as grit.
reaction: The visible crystals made the difference between clear water and treated drinking water memorable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Evaporating the filtered water was most worthwhile because the crystals demonstrated that clear water can still contain dissolved salts.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filtering was a predictable, only-available step, although it set up the useful comparison with dissolved material.

surprise.text: The salt crystals made the earlier water-treatment explanation concrete: the cloth caught grit but did not remove dissolved salts.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each followed the goal of examining what the ice water carried.

continue.text: I would personally continue because this chapter connected a simple experiment to the cabin’s water treatment, and I am curious what the preserved banded ice might reveal.
